newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen easing in thin demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen easing in thin demand.

text.p: Pakistan gold rates are set to ease this week on an estimated 40 percent drop in demand for gold jewellery even though the wedding season is in full swing, dealers said on Sunday.
"There are 40 percent less buyers of jewellery this year compared to last year," said Saeed Qureshi, a member of the All Pakistan Gem and Jewellers Association.
International gold prices were falling amid irregular selling by Central Asian states but remained mixed in Pakistan, with wedding season demand offset by a cash shortage, he said.
Another dealer said consumers were holding onto their cash due to political uncertainty ahead of the February 3 election.
